title: Chapter 856
text:
In the Flickering World, the remaining soldiers of the Arcane Church were basically wiped out by the dynasty. A large number of spaceships were seized, and countless soldiers were captured.

Mercer and Heber fought for a very long time. The two Pugilists kept exchanging blows, and the Pugilist flames were like sparks from clashing weapons. Their fists, which contained explosive power, landed heavily on each other's bodies time and time again.

The Beyond Grade A Pugilist was the embodiment of the true meaning of speed and strength. His movements were as fast as lightning, leaving behind countless afterimages. His exquisite melee combat skills were the combination of strength and beauty. Milizaus and the others rarely engaged in melee combat, so watching the show from the side was simply pleasing to the eye.

In the end, the two of them were completely exhausted and covered in wounds. Their chests heaved up and down violently. Heber's condition was slightly better. With his bulging muscles, he firmly held onto Mercer and brought him back to the spaceship.

Bang!

Mercer's heavy body was thrown onto the deck. He was in a semi-conscious state, and he could not get up again.

Heber took a deep breath, calmed down the restless blood in his body, and looked around at the people in the room. He then pointed at Mercer and said with a deep voice, "It's done."

Clap clap clap clap … Sparse applause could be heard in the room. Tarrokov and the others gave him face and clapped with polite smiles on their faces.

With Black Star's feat of instantly killing Dylan in a desperate situation, they did not feel any admiration for Heber's feat of deliberately creating a one-on-one environment to defeat an opponent who was already injured. They even felt that it was too slow. However, they did not dare say it out loud to offend Heber.

Han Xiao was different. He was not afraid of Heber. With a drink in his hand, he bit on the straw and said with a muffled voice, "So slow, little Ty-Ty. Why did you fight for so long?"

The two Pugilists had been fighting for quite some time, and the battlefield had long been cleaned up. The spectators had already relaxed and started to eat and drink.

"Humph." Heber was not bothered by it.

No matter what, the achievement of defeating Mercer was already his. In the future, no one would talk about all the details. Everyone would only know that he had defeated a Beyond Grade A. With this title, it was more than enough to intimidate everyone.

Tarrokov clapped his hands and gestured for everyone to look over before he continued.

"Since Heber is here, let's repeat what happened earlier. I've already informed Uranril about the results of this battle, and Her Excellency is very satisfied with our results. The Arcane Church's assault troops were basically wiped out, and the dynasty now has two Beyond Grade As in Dylan and Mercer.

With such chips, the dynasty has the upper hand. Her Excellency the Ruler will announce this matter to the entire universe and let all the organizations in the universe know the Arcane Church's actions. and the universe will see the price they have to pay.... "

The pursuit in the Flickering World did not last long, and the dynasty was still blocking the news. The outside world was still in the dark, and it was only a matter of time before they announced it to the entire universe.

If the Arcane Church had escaped unscathed after the assault, the dynasty's prestige would have taken a hit. However, it was different now. The Arcane Church had gone for wool and come home shorn. Not only were their troops wiped out, but two of their six Beyond Grade As were also captured by the dynasty. The dynasty's prestige did not decrease but instead increased. The upper echelons of the dynasty were extremely satisfied with the actions of Han Xiao and the others.

The dynasty would not let go of such an opportunity to promote their own Beyond Grade As. Han Xiao was the focus of the promotion, and the dynasty was prepared to write about how he had turned the situation around.

Increasing the prestige of the dynasty's allies would also increase the prestige of the dynasty. It was a win-win situation.

When the Tyrant was wrestling with Mercer earlier, Tarrokov had already informed Han Xiao. Therefore, Han Xiao only raised his eyebrows to indicate that he understood.

"On the other hand, there are still four Beyond Grade As who escaped into the Shattered Star Ring. The dynasty will try to hunt them down. However, the situation in the Shattered Star Ring is different from the Flickering World. Everyone, the dynasty hopes that you can temporarily head to the Shattered Star Ring to hold the fort."

The Flickering World was currently the dynasty's territory, and the other organizations did not have any foundation there. Therefore, the dynasty could set up an inescapable blockade to chase after the enemies without being disturbed by outsiders.

However, the environment of the Shattered Star Ring was different. The various organizations were complicated, and the Arcane Church also had various spies in the Shattered Star Ring. Sagman and the other Beyond Grade As no longer had only one way to escape. They could split up and disguise themselves as some galactic civilization's citizens, making it easier for them to hide their tracks.

Furthermore, with the entire Star Field as the range, the difficulty of the dynasty chasing after the enemies would increase exponentially. It would be like looking for a needle in a haystack.

Of course, Sagman and the others were in great danger. As the prey, the pressure on them was much greater.

Because the enemies had increased the distance between them through the secret stargate, the dynasty's Beyond Grade As could not continue to chase after them. They could only choose to head to the Shattered Star Ring. After all, the enemies would definitely be hiding, and they could only attack when they found traces of the enemies.

Han Xiao smiled and said, "The Shattered Star Ring is the Shattered Star Ring.

"The Shattered Star Ring is the main camp of the Black Star Army. I sincerely invite all of you here to visit the Black Star Army as guests. While you're here, I'll take care of your meals and lodging."

Heber immediately said, "The Shattered Star Ring is also my territory. The Black Star Corps has only been established for a few years, so there's nothing much to see. Everyone, come to my Bloodshed Land."

Everyone present was a Beyond Grade A and had extraordinary influence. As the local tyrants, both of them wanted to pull the others over to their organizations as guests. This would indirectly increase the reputation of their organizations.

Milizaus chuckled and said, "Since Black Star has invited me, I'll go to your place."

Beyoni nodded and said, "Alright, you promised to host me in the Central Galaxy last time. Let's make use of this opportunity."

The two of them had stayed with Han Xiao on Planet Lighthouse for a month, and they had even fought side by side not long ago. With such a comrade-in-arms, their relationship was naturally much closer.

"Black Star, I'll go to your place too. We'll make use of this opportunity to talk about mechanical technology," Maximiler said through the remote projection.

"No problem," Han Xiao agreed without hesitation.

Maximiler was a Mechanic, so his interest in his peers was naturally higher than his interest in a muscular guy.

The few of them ignored Heber's invitation. Heber's expression stiffened, and he felt a little embarrassed. He then turned to look at Ravenlaude.

Ravenlaude's mouth twitched, and he coughed before helplessly saying, "Then … I'll go to Bloodshed Land then."

Although he did not get along with Han Xiao, everyone else had gone to the Black Star Corps. He also wanted to join in the fun and see if he could find a chance to use the Evolution Cube. However, being stared at by Heber gave him a headache. In the end, he could only say one thing and mean another.

Heber's expression became a little better. At least not everyone ignored him.

However, looking at the three people on Han Xiao's side, Heber felt an inexplicable sense of defeat.

He had been managing the Tyrant's Party in the Shattered Star Ring for many years and thought that he had a lot of connections. However, outside of the Shattered Star Ring, the experts of the same level in the other Star Fields might not even give him face. He felt that he had lost to Han Xiao in terms of connections and did not feel good.

Tarrokov coughed and interrupted everyone's conversation.

"Due to the increased difficulty of the search, the dynasty has decided to cut off the enemy's path of retreat in advance. In other words, they will attack the stargate station of the Arcane Church in the Shattered Star Ring so that they will not be able to return to the Central Galaxy quickly.

The dynasty's ambassador in the Shattered Star Ring, Zoel, is already dispatching troops. When the dynasty announces this matter, they will attack. "

"Then, it seems like we won't be able to make it in time." Han Xiao nodded. "Neither side has any Beyond Grade As. Will the dynasty's troops in the Shattered Star Ring be able to get rid of the Arcane Church's troops?"

"You guessed wrong. We have Beyond Grade A combatants."

Han Xiao was stunned. "Did the dynasty invite other Beyond Grade A allies from the other Star Fields? Won't there not be enough time? The Arcane Church also has the time to send Beyond Grade A combatants. "

"No, our Beyond Grade A combatants are local to the Shattered Star Ring."

"Local? Heber and I are both in the Flickering World. Austin is on his way back and won't be able to make it in time, let alone Sisko … "

As he said that, Han Xiao suddenly realized something. His expression sank, and his tone was unfriendly.

"You guys used my name to ask Ames for help?"

"Black Star, you've misunderstood. It was not us. The Dragon Emperor took the initiative to look for Zoel and requested to participate in the attack on the stargate station."

Tarrokov waved his hands. "I only found out about this not too long ago. Zoel has already promised her. With you guys not around, she's the only Beyond Grade A in the Shattered Star Ring. She can provide a huge amount of help."

"How did she know what happened here?"

"This … I don't know." Tarrokov shook his head.

Han Xiao frowned, walked to the side, and contacted Ames.

Ames' projection appeared. Seeing Han Xiao, she sized him up and said with a smile that did not seem like a smile, "Yo, busy guy, you're finally willing to look for me?"

Han Xiao did not beat around the bush and asked directly, "Let me ask you, did you contact the dynasty and prepare to interfere in this matter?"

"Why, do you have a problem with that?" Ames' lips curled up.

Han Xiao nodded and said with a deep voice, "You shouldn't interfere.

"You shouldn't get involved. This isn't a good thing for you."

"Is this your first day knowing me?" Ames' tone was calm. "To me, there are only things I want to do and things I don't want to do. You're my ally, and if I don't help you when you're attacked, what kind of ally am I? Humph, you're still hiding it from me. If not for Austin telling me, I wouldn't even know that you're in such danger in the Flickering World. "

So, it's that old man Austin …

Han Xiao was helpless. "I'm not hiding it from you. I just didn't tell you for the time being. I don't think there's a need for me to inform you immediately …"

"… Sometimes, I really want to beat you to death." Ames snorted. "It's a pity that you've become so much stronger. I don't have the confidence to beat you now."

Han Xiao scratched his chin and said helplessly, "Don't change the topic. Even if you don't interfere, the dynasty can still attack the stargate. You don't have to do this. You're not a member of the dynasty and don't have the protection of the dynasty. If you anger the Arcane Church, your situation will be very troublesome."

"Is that so? What about Austin? You don't seem to be thinking about him at all. "Ames' tone was mocking.

"How is that the same?" Han Xiao shook his head. "Austin owes me a favor, but you don't. Instead, I owe you a favor. Plus, we're on the same side, so of course I'm thinking about you."

"Tsk, so you still know how to talk like a human."

Ames joked before her tone became serious. "Alright, you don't have to say anymore. You know, as long as I make a decision, even Aesop won't be able to change my mind."

"… Alright."

Han Xiao was helpless but also a little touched. When he was weak, Ames had also supported him like this. Although she was now a big shot on the same level, she still did the same. Those old memories seemed to have come back to life.

"Then, be careful."

After hanging up, Han Xiao contacted Zoel.

"Haha, Your Excellency Black Star, it's been a while."

Zoel's face appeared, and he laughed heartily.

"I've heard about your contributions in the Flickering World. Well done."

Back then, it was Zoel who introduced Han Xiao to the dynasty. Now that Han Xiao had made a contribution, he had also received a certain amount of praise, so he was in a very good mood.

"Zoel, I have something to ask of you …" Han Xiao told him his request.

"That's all? Don't worry, I'll tell the garrison commander not to order the Dragon Emperor to carry out the most dangerous attack when they attack the stargate station."

"Alright, I'll return to the Shattered Star Ring soon. Come to the Black Star Corps headquarters then, and we'll have a good gathering. Milizaus, Beyoni, and Maximiler will also be there."

"They're all big shots." Zoel's eyes sparkled. With his position, he would at most come into contact with the Beyond Grade As of the Shattered Star Ring. He would not have the chance to meet these Beyond Grade As of the other Star Fields.

After ending the call, Han Xiao returned to Tarrokov and the others. With the help of the others, he used the Spacetime Amber to seal Mercer, who was struggling and howling in pain.

Then, the fleet turned around and began their return journey. They would return to the Shattered Star Ring through the stargate in the Dawn Star Cluster, which would take a few days.

Originally, Han Xiao thought that he would have to stay in the Flickering World forever. He did not expect that because of this small incident, he would be able to take some time out to return to the main camp.

However, it did not matter where he was. The Black Star Corps continued to explore the Flickering World as planned.

Opening the forums, Han Xiao realized that the [Red Empire's Order — Full Pursuit] mission had not ended yet. There were still many Arcane Church teams scattered in other directions, and there were still many Fallen Ark teams that had not escaped.

Compared to the remaining four, Han Xiao wanted to deal with EsGod more. However, the dynasty's focus was on the Arcane Church.

Without the help of his teammates, Han Xiao did not have the confidence to kill EsGod.

I can only wait for the Red Empire to announce this matter to the entire universe and launch a large-scale counterattack before trying to convince the dynasty to accept my suggestion …

Han Xiao thought to himself, Political assets should be able to have some influence in this area …

…

On the second day after capturing Mercer, the Red Empire held a press conference in between the daily news. Ruler Uranril personally made a statement and announced the cause of this incident to the entire universe.

Countless galactic media outlets broadcasted the video of this speech to every galactic civilization in the various star fields.

Be it the official platform, the television, or the entertainment channel, the scene was all switched to the dynasty's statement.

The captains in spaceships all took out their communicators and stared at the broadcast. The bartenders and customers in the bars all looked up at the screen above their heads. The passengers in the galactic transit stations all looked up at the dome projection in midair.

Countless galactic residents heard the Red Empire's announcement at the same time.

The galactic residents only knew that the Flickering World was a new Star Field that was being developed. They did not know anything else. However, in this unknown Star Field that they could not see, a battle between eleven Beyond Grade As actually happened. The Arcane Church and the Red Empire had a head-on conflict, and both Universal Civilizations announced that they had entered a state of emergency!

This announcement threw a psionic bomb to the entire galactic society, causing huge waves!
